containment_scope.boundary_note: Query-in-document containment indexes only normalized benchmark queries at or above min_normalized_chars; shorter queries are skipped to avoid ubiquitous-substring false positives.

exact_scope.boundary_note: Exact equality indexes every nonempty normalized benchmark query, including queries shorter than the containment boundary.

example_policy.exact_and_containment: limited independently per source per kind
example_policy.near_duplicate_overlap: limited independently from exact and containment per source

near_scope.boundary_note: Near-duplicate MinHash is not a full corpus scan: every eligible long benchmark query is indexed, while only deterministic bottom-k eligible documents from each train/validation shard are queried. Exact equality and query-in-document containment still scan every valid pretraining document.
near_scope.sampling_method: deterministic SHA256 bottom-k independently per physical shard

task_alignment.note: MiniMind does not pin lm-evaluation-harness; freeze its commit before formal scoring.

success_marker.write_order: atomic audit report first, then atomic marker

token_accounting.chunk_digest: SHA256 over BOS/raw/EOS token ids encoded uint32 little-endian
token_accounting.implementation_alignment: Matches minimind/dataset/lm_dataset.py PretrainDataset with add_special_tokens=False, truncation at sequence_length-2, then BOS/EOS and right padding.
